author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A hearty village lunch with homemade meat cutlets, fresh vegetables, and comforting potato pilaf makes the perfect rustic meal 🌿🥩 In this video, we prepare everything from simple ingredients using traditional countryside cooking methods.

The meat cutlets are cooked until beautifully browned and juicy, while fresh vegetables add color and freshness to the table. The potato pilaf is warm, filling, and full of homemade flavor, making it a perfect side for the savory cutlets.

This rustic lunch is all about simple ingredients, generous portions, and comforting village food. Tender meat cutlets, seasonal vegetables, and hearty potato pilaf come together in a satisfying family meal made to be enjoyed around the table. 🥔🥕🔥
title: Rustic Village Lunch | Meat Cutlets, Vegetables & Potato Pilaf  🌿🥩
